verdict: Correctly uses real bl-* components and attributes (bl-tab-group with slot="tabs" + default panels slot, bl-tab name, bl-tab-panel tab, bl-tooltip placement + tooltip-trigger slot, bl-button size/icon) which match the actual Baklava API; the single defect is a hallucinated slot="tooltip" on the tooltip content span, which should live in the default slot, so the tooltip help text will not be slotted and the popover renders empty.
